en: Globitermes brachycerastes is an orange-yellow species. In the soldier the head is orange, the mandibles reddish brown and paler at their bases, and the thoracic and abdominal tergites lighter than the head. Pilosity is sparse: only a few long setae stand on the head, the antennal segments carry numerous short hairs mixed with scattered long ones, and the thoracic tergites bear sparse long setae. The original account characterizes no alate or worker caste, so the species is known mainly from soldier coloration and chaetotaxy.
soldier: 头橘黄，上颚红褐而基部略淡，胸部与腹部背板比头色浅。头部的毛很少，仅有若干长毛；触角各节着生较多短毛，并夹有稀疏长毛；胸部背板疏生长毛。
